title: Containers: Keep Values Together
summary: A container holds a group of values. A vector is like a row of boxes. A map is like a book that pairs each word with an answer.
introduction: A container holds a group of values. A vector is like a row of boxes. A map is like a book that pairs each word with an answer. Read one example at a time. Save it in a .cpp file and use the compiler from the setup lesson to run it.
learningObjectives: Add values to a list with vector
Look up a value by its name with map
Keep just one copy of each value with set

blocks.text: A vector is a list that can grow. The first item has number 0. push_back adds an item at the end.
